title: Sweet Escape to Sri Lanka: Kandy, Bentota and Colombo
alt: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic beside Kandy lake
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel in the hills above Kandy town

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

activities.name: Half day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the giant Bahiravokanda Buddha above the town and the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights in Kandy with the elephants on the way up, the dance show and a half day of the city.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class beach resort on the Bentota shore

activities.name: Excursion to Galle and Mirissa
activities.description: South along the coast to the Dutch fort at Galle with its ramparts and lighthouse, then on to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with a free afternoon and a day out to Galle fort and Mirissa.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night in Colombo with a full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon
An evening lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The hilltop Buddha at Bahiravokanda and Peradeniya gardens
The afternoon free in the lakeside bazaars
3: Breakfast and a transfer down to the south west coast
Check in at your beach resort by early afternoon
The rest of the day at leisure by the pool or the sea
Optional: a sunset catamaran ride on the Bentota river
4: Breakfast and an excursion along the southern coast
The Dutch fort at Galle: ramparts, lighthouse and old church
Mirissa beach and sunset from Coconut Tree Hill
5: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Six easy days: two nights in Kandy with the Pinnawala elephants and the dance show, two on the beach at Bentota with a day at Galle and Mirissa, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 5 nights in deluxe and standard class hotels with breakfast and dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; half day Kandy sightseeing; a day excursion to Galle and Mirissa; full day Colombo sightseeing.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
